Provide practice problems that require finding patterns or counting occurrences within strings by checking all possible starting positions. Emphasize the difference between finding the first/last occurrence (indexOf/lastIndexOf) and iterating to find all occurrences or specific patterns, especially when the pattern can appear anywhere or multiple times.
